original_test_intent: Demonstrate a secure PLDM BKC bundle update through Redfish reaches terminal success and activates every source-specified component version without bricking or degrading the platform.
original_method: Authenticate a signed compatible bundle and baseline, upload/apply via documented TLS Redfish, follow its returned task URI to a terminal state without interruption, perform governed activation/recovery, then compare all seven active resources and full health evidence.
manual_activity: Firmware engineer/operator authorizes the exact bundle/Redfish transaction and supervises recovery; engineer resolves component/task mismatches and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Signed BKC bundle/image hash/manifest and exact target platform
Redfish UpdateService upload/apply schema, TLS/credential and task semantics
Current inventory plus all seven expected source values
Stable power/network, maintenance, OOB and backup/rollback
safety_requirements: Verify artifact signature/checksum/platform compatibility before upload
Exclude active/concurrent updates and establish backup/OOB
Capture returned task URI; never assume numeric task ID
Do not interrupt, reboot/power-cycle, start workloads or retry blindly
After terminal result verify all active components and health before further action
agent_execution_scope: Validate supplied bundle/baseline and documented endpoint
Perform only the explicitly approved authenticated update
Monitor the actual task and collect seven exact post-checks
Do not choose artifact/target, invent API, retry, recover autonomously or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve bundle/target/schema/version matrix and critical change
Review task, versions and health; decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic UpdateService assistance omits the exact artifact, dynamic task and seven-member oracle; source HTTP/task0 examples are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented authenticated TLS upload/apply workflow, monitor its returned task URI to terminal state, then query every exact active resource and compare all literal target values.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BKC_X23.49.0_76 identity, approximately 20-minute monitoring and all seven versions/resources are retained; source 5/5 estimates do not override task completion.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an immutable transaction ledger from bundle hash/current matrix through request/task events to active post-matrix, activation and system health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Secures/task-scopes the update while preserving all component coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Seven component checks and the bundle task are both required; one cannot substitute for the other.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Multi-component activation may be staged or require reboot; vendor task semantics and recovery must be approved before execution.

project_override_considerations: Changing any literal target or using another bundle requires an approved decision; no current/latest version may replace the source matrix implicitly.
expected_evidence: Critical approval, signed image/manifest/hash and target compatibility
Pre-flash seven-component active inventory and platform health
Authenticated request/upload/apply results and actual task URI
Complete task state/progress/error/audit timeline with power/OOB continuity
Post-flash seven exact active versions and bundle identity
Activation/recovery, GPU/driver/BMC/SMC/SEL health, rollback readiness and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently define one BKC bundle Redfish update and explicit post-version matrix; insecure examples are execution defects, not competing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Signed artifact and governed update inputs can be supplied; static review is complete without mutation.

review_improvement: Expands a generic firmware update into a signed, authenticated, task-tracked multi-component transaction with exact seven-version and recovery proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: HTTP success on upload does not mean the asynchronous update succeeded, and task number 0 can reference an old or unrelated operation. The returned task URI and its terminal state must be bound to the uploaded image hash. Because a BKC bundle spans seven components, a partial update can leave mixed firmware even when one member matches, so the complete active matrix and platform health are indispensable.
